parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string form. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: spaceIdentifier
parameters.description: project ID, equivalent to projectId; the UUID of the project

parameters.name: spaceType
parameters.description: resource type; currently defaults to Project

parameters.name: workitemTypeIdentifier
parameters.description: Work item type ID, which can be obtained from the ListProjectWorkitemTypes API and corresponds to the identifier field.
